panels.title: Unique installs per month (12 months)
panels.description: Distinct install ids active in each of the last 12 calendar months, from rollups_daily.active_install. Matches GET /v1/summary's installs_per_month.

targets.queryText: SELECT substr(day,1,7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS unique_installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT substr(day,1,7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS unique_installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Weekly active installs (12 weeks)
panels.description: Distinct install ids active per week, from rollups_daily.active_install. Uses SQLite's strftime('%W') (Monday-based week-of-year); this can disagree with the API's ISO week numbering right at a year boundary, so treat this as a trend view rather than a byte-for-byte match to /v1/summary.

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', day) AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS active_installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 12
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', day) AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS active_installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Agent distribution (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Install-days per agent over the trailing 30 rolled-up days: an install active on 10 different days contributes 10, once per day it reported that agent. Not distinct installs. Matches GET /v1/summary's agent_distribution.

targets.queryText: SELECT key AS agent, SUM(value) AS install_days FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'agent' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY key ORDER BY install_days DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT key AS agent, SUM(value) AS install_days FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'agent' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY key ORDER BY install_days DESC

panels.title: Component distribution (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Install-days per component over the trailing 30 rolled-up days, same install-days semantics as agent distribution. Matches GET /v1/summary's component_distribution.

targets.queryText: SELECT key AS component, SUM(value) AS install_days FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'component' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY key ORDER BY install_days DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT key AS component, SUM(value) AS install_days FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'component' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY key ORDER BY install_days DESC

panels.title: RDD enabled ratio (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Share of install-days over the trailing 30 rolled-up days reporting rdd_enabled=true. Matches GET /v1/summary's rdd_enabled_ratio.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'true' THEN value ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(value), 0) AS rdd_enabled_ratio FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'rdd_enabled' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'true' THEN value ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(value), 0) AS rdd_enabled_ratio FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'rdd_enabled' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day')

panels.title: Version distribution (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Install-days per reported version over the trailing 30 rolled-up days. A useful proxy for upgrade lag. Matches GET /v1/summary's version_distribution.

targets.queryText: SELECT key AS version, SUM(value) AS install_days FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'version' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY key ORDER BY install_days DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT key AS version, SUM(value) AS install_days FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'version' AND day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY key ORDER BY install_days DESC

panels.title: Events per day
panels.description: Raw event volume (install + heartbeat), bounded by --retention-days: older raw rows are purged, so this panel only ever shows the retention window, unlike the rollup-backed panels above which cover full history.

targets.queryText: SELECT date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM events GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM events GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

panels.title: npm downloads per day (gentle-pi, gentle-engram)
panels.description: Daily download counts from the npm registry's public API (api.npmjs.org) — a public count, not telemetry from any gentle-ai install. Matches GET /v1/summary's downloads.npm. The gentle_pi and gentle_engram columns mirror the collector's default --npm-package list; any other package it is configured to fetch lands in other_packages so nothing is silently dropped.

targets.queryText: SELECT day, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-pi' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_pi, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-engram' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_engram, SUM(CASE WHEN key NOT IN ('gentle-pi', 'gentle-engram') THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS other_packages FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT day, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-pi' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_pi, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-engram' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_engram, SUM(CASE WHEN key NOT IN ('gentle-pi', 'gentle-engram') THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS other_packages FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

panels.title: gentle-ai release downloads (cumulative per tag)
panels.description: Cumulative GitHub release asset download counts per tag, from the public GitHub API (api.github.com) — a public count, not telemetry from any gentle-ai install. Each bar is the latest known total for that tag, not a per-day delta. Matches GET /v1/summary's downloads.github.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS tag, r.value AS total_downloads FROM rollups_daily r INNER JOIN (SELECT key, MAX(day) AS max_day FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' GROUP BY key) latest ON latest.key = r.key AND latest.max_day = r.day WHERE r.metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' ORDER BY total_downloads DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.key AS tag, r.value AS total_downloads FROM rollups_daily r INNER JOIN (SELECT key, MAX(day) AS max_day FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' GROUP BY key) latest ON latest.key = r.key AND latest.max_day = r.day WHERE r.metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' ORDER BY total_downloads DESC
